# MoMoFit

MoMoFit is an online custom sportswear design studio for basketball jerseys, soccer kits, Polo shirts, T-shirts, and team apparel.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://arawear.online/aijersey/
- Product list: https://arawear.online/aijersey/products
- Sitemap: https://arawear.online/aijersey/sitemap.xml

## What The Site Offers

- Online 3D preview for custom team apparel.
- Product templates for basketball, soccer, Polo, T-shirt, and team clothing.
- Customizable team names, player numbers, colors, logos, and patterns.
- Design package export for customer support and production handoff.
